bearer.description: An API key created on dotMARC's Access page.

info.description: Read domains, DNS health, DMARC report summaries, groups, tags and alerts, and add, import and organise domains. Authenticate with an API key from dotMARC's Access page: `Authorization: Bearer dmk_...`. Each operation needs the permission named in its description, and a key limited to certain groups only sees their domains. Each key may make 120 requests a minute.
